label: First-order variance propagation
subgoals: Linearize the output about the nominal point
Square each sensitivity times its sigma
Sum the terms and take the square root for the output sigma

label: Ranking the contributors
subgoals: Divide each term by the total variance for its share
Rank parameters by the product of sensitivity and sigma

label: Estimating sensitivities by simulation
subgoals: Simulate the output at plus and minus one step
Divide the difference by twice the step
Choose the step to balance simulator noise against curvature
